changelog:
1. Cross-Network Calling Fixed: Flawless calling between different Wi-Fi networks and mobile data
2. 24/7 Deep Sleep Keepalive: Background watchdog reconnects MQTT automatically so sleeping phones never go offline
3. Single Global Broker: Unified to broker.emqx.io, eliminating broker split-brain isolation
4. Standby & Active Status: Shows real-time Online and Standby ready-to-call states
5. Battery Optimization Exemption: Keeps sockets open in Android Doze mode
